evidence: ReplayEngine owns immutable cases, adapter-bound offline observations, and paired comparison; target implementations and promotion remain external.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep target execution and promotion outside replay persistence.

evidence: Replay cases reference only completed task identity; adapters receive a frozen context through one protocol rather than target-specific runtime internals.
dimensions.recommendation: Add target-specific adapters without adding target-specific columns.

evidence: Closed case and request schemas, four target kinds, required version hashes, adapter identity, bounded metrics, Python execution, and report-only CLI are explicit.
dimensions.recommendation: Version the case or observation schema before adding metrics.

evidence: Schema v70 owns immutable replay inputs and observations; source tasks remain authoritative for completion and targets remain externally versioned.
dimensions.recommendation: Do not derive cases from ordinary task objectives or retain raw adapter output.

evidence: Tests cover four target kinds, paired deltas, privacy and secret gates, unsafe adapters, invalid observations, immutability, idempotency, Safe Mode, CLI reports, migration, and rollback.
dimensions.recommendation: Add held-out real fixtures only after leakage review.

evidence: Adapter isolation is self-declared, case and evaluator data are caller-authored, and paired replay does not control confounding, distribution shift, or leakage.
impact_path: A host supplies an adapter that violates its declared isolation or a biased replay fixture.
The engine records apparently favorable offline metrics.
A downstream operator could mistake those observations for production improvement.
dimensions.recommendation: Use an independently sandboxed host and continuous quality gates before any promotion decision.

evidence: Core replay storage and comparison are provider neutral; the injected adapter is the only target execution boundary and the default adapter is unavailable.
dimensions.recommendation: Keep provider credentials and raw responses outside replay storage.

evidence: Cases retain exact input and evaluator hashes while run rows retain adapter and target identities, enabling later re-evaluation without changing source tasks.
dimensions.recommendation: Preserve v1 rows and compare new harness versions rather than rewriting them.

abstractions.purpose: Evaluate versioned runtime targets on immutable sanitized cases through an isolated injected adapter.
use_evidence: Used by public Python service methods and report-only replay CLI over schema v70.
complexity_cost: One module, two immutable tables, migration 70, service methods, four report-management CLI commands, documentation, and focused tests.
abstractions.recommendation: Retain while the offline evaluation requirement exists.
